title: A Cow of Our Own
offer: With the east meadow, we have room for a cow at last! Buy one at the horse farm in Torsgården. A cow is big, but she fits in your boat like a crate, if she stands still.

steps.say: Look at her big brown eyes! She will give us milk every day. Let us call her Rosa.

fact: Cows were the wealth of a farm: a family counted its riches in cows.
